ValidationRule.description: Advertisement/Campaign field is mandatory for Promotion Case Types in NA market.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'NA_Promotion', ISBLANK( Advertisement__c), ISPICKVAL( Country_Code__c ,'US'), CreatedDate > DATETIMEVALUE( "2022-07-25 00:00:00" ), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Status ,'New')), OR(CONTAINS(Text(NA1_Category_Level_3__c),"Coke UTC"), CONTAINS(Text(NA1_Category_Level_3__c),"General Promo")) )
